question: Can freezing BN affine rescue training-side learning under the exact old TA input bank and fixed short budget?
purpose: training implementation/measurement diagnosis only; known FrozenBN control, not original contribution or augmentation-benefit evaluation
invariant: both arms on same local MPS FP32, same ResNet18/ImageNetV1 weight, Linear512to2 seed0, BN running stats fixed; all non-BN-affine backbone parameters train in both arms
data: 64 already used training photos only; exact 16-pass1024-image old TA bank and order regenerated and checked against old RGB hashes; no development/test photo access or evaluation
augmentation: torchvision TrivialAugmentWide31bins NEAREST fill128 after bilinearresize256 centercrop224, before ImageNet normalization

evaluation.TA_bank: first already-generated training pass; secondary diagnostic, not held out

gate.learned: final clean training accuracy>=.9 AND mean LL<=.2nat
gate.underlearning: final clean training accuracy<=.8 OR mean LL>=.5nat
gate.positive_diagnostic: MPS affine-trainable control underlearning AND affine-frozen learned; supports role only in this fixed development setting
gate.otherwise: if MPS control not underlearning, old CPU failure not reproduced, cannot attribute old failure; if no rescue report failure and stop

stop: nonfinite loss/gradient/parameters, mismatched controls, wall or compute cap; no more steps/seeds/retuning
